meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试 Senpi 适配器隔离运行，确保不污染真实环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改动过 Senpi 适配器代码，想要隔离验证却不想碰真实数据。
copy.tagline_en: Test the Senpi adapter in isolation without touching your real environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Senpi adapter and need isolated QA without touching real data.

howto.what: 这套技能让 Claude 能对 Senpi 适配器做真实质检：运行真正的 senpi 程序，在隔离目录中执行，不接触你现有的 senpi 环境。所有产物与报告会存入固定的证据目录；若没有 senpi，会如实报告 SKIP。
howto.when: 当你修改了 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的代码，或想测试/验证/调试 Senpi 适配器、任务引擎、DAG 等，或提到“senpi qa”等触发词时，这个技能就会被使用。

say.text: 请对 senpi 适配器做一次完整 QA。
say.note: Claude 会运行隔离测试并把证据存档。

say.text: 测试一下 senpi 任务的启动、执行和结束流程。
say.note: 会调用真实 senpi 跑任务生命周期。

say.text: 帮我验证这次的改动没污染真实 senpi 环境。
say.note: 会检查隔离目录和写入路径。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude QA the Senpi adapter against the real senpi binary in an isolated directory, leaving your existing senpi environment untouched. All artifacts and reports are written to a fixed evidence directory; if senpi is missing, it reports SKIP.
howto.when_en: Use when you changed code under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or want to test/verify/debug the Senpi adapter, task/team engine, DAG, etc., or say a trigger like "senpi qa".

say_en.text: Run a full QA on the senpi adapter.
say_en.note: Claude runs isolated tests and stores evidence.

say_en.text: Test the start, run, and finish of a senpi task.
say_en.note: Runs the task-e2e driver against real senpi.

say_en.text: Verify my recent change doesn't touch the real senpi env.
say_en.note: Checks isolation dirs and changed-path fields.
